title: SearchQA admission and 2WikiMultiHopQA payload materialization
objective: Bind the admitted SearchQA calibration identities and materialize a hash-bound, gold-bearing 2WikiMultiHopQA pool with deterministic disjoint partitions and frozen automatic verification contracts.

source.normative_release_description: April 7 2021 ID-bearing release with corrected paragraph sentence segmentation
source.transport_limitation: The author-hosted Dropbox endpoint timed out repeatedly from the execution environment. The author repository remains normative; Kaggle is used only as the byte transport mirror and is independently schema-audited.

task_type_contract.source: dataset type metadata frozen before model responses

verifier_contract.answer: lowercase, remove ASCII punctuation and English articles, collapse whitespace, then exact match against answer plus aliases for answer_id
verifier_contract.supporting_evidence: case-insensitive set equality over [title, sentence_index] pairs
verifier_contract.joint_success: answer exact match and supporting evidence exact set match

partition_contract.method: sequentially select unassigned IDs sorted by sha256(seed + ':' + id)

decision_gate.pass: All 12 SearchQA calibration identities bind to complete local question, context, and answer payloads; both mirrored 2Wiki files match declared byte sizes; every development record passes schema, ID, evidence, context-index, answer-ID, and task-type checks; all four partitions have exact counts and are pairwise disjoint; verifier fixtures pass; no provider or paid calls occur.
decision_gate.failure: Keep provider execution closed and preserve visible acquisition/audit provenance.
